rubric.criterion: Recognizes one connection and transaction around the whole batch. Does not invent partial commits, duplicated balances or a demonstrated concurrency race.
Traces validation, debit, credit and receipt recording; names the knowledge the internal coordinator retains and rehearses fee policy changes without inventing an approved fee contract.

A concrete smaller shape preserves checks, retry/fencing order and rollback. A justified KEEP is acceptable if it shows hidden knowledge and addresses coordination cost. File/class count alone is insufficient.
No source edits, new fee implementation, concurrency framework or compatibility migration without a real consumer.
Names behavioral proof across individual and batch paths, prefix failure, exact/conflicting retries and generator error; public happy paths alone are insufficient.
